g.text: Each bar spans the parameter's credible range (others held central). The workload mix dominates everything

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #7b8794

g.text: else and is the one input here with no source: its low end is NVIDIA's measured replaceability floor, its

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #7b8794

g.text: centre this study's own assertion. The result stays positive across every range shown, but its magnitude

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #7b8794

g.text: ranges from 27 to 60 percent and is not robust to that assumption.
